'''Assimilated Pigs''', known internally as '''Infpig''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Pigs. Assimilated Pigs do not currently possess an [[Assimara Parasites|Assimara version]] at the time of writing, much like [[Assimilated Horse|Assimilated Horses]]. The implications of this are unknown.


== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Pig succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 4 Pigs have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Pigs are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Pig will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Pigs are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Pigs are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Pig gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
* If an Assimilated Pig gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into Moving Flesh, it will evolve into a [[Feral Pig]].
* On death, Assimilated Pigs have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 2 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance that an Assimilated Pig drops its [[Walking Pig Head|Head]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Pigs, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
